title: OpenToM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Theory-of-Mind Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes Multi-Hop (MHop) questions designed to evaluate LLMs' understanding of 'social commonsense' and 'social norms,' explicitly citing an example involving the norm of not taking items from another person's backpack without permission. This directly benchmarks ethical/moral reasoning within a social context.
